column1: # THE EIGHT PRODUCTION POLYC PARSER AUTHORITIES, REPROVED AT C3.
# This is NOT a symbols-only count.  For EACH authority:
#   (1) the SYMBOL is DEFINED exactly once in the linked executable;
#   (2) the PRODUCTION CALLER OBJECT imports it (nm: one U);
#   (3) the caller object does NOT define it (no T in the same object);
#   (4) the SELECTOR is ON in the live CMake cache;
#   (5) the decision site carries REAL RELOCATIONS to the PolyC symbol;
#   (6) the legacy oracle survives as a PASS-THROUGH STUB.
# --- THE RETIRED C DECISIONS ARE COMPILED OUT ---
# Each legacy oracle body below is a SINGLE branch-to-next-address,
# which is the relocation slot for the PolyC symbol.  There is NO
# comparison, NO constant load and NO branch on the decision.
# The tracked source is UNCHANGED from the entry tree: a reconnaissance
# ACT makes no production source change.
